managing workflows.

## The 5 traps of enterprise AI and how to escape them

These aren’t new problems. They’re the same data governance failures enterprises have faced for 35
years, now running at AI speed. Strategy has watched this pattern repeat itself across thousands of
deployments. The difference today is the stakes: your AI agents are making decisions  at scale, not
just reporting on them. Mosaic was built to close these gaps at the infrastructure level.

[extension_100dp_FA660F_FILL0_wght400_GRAD0_opsz48.svg]

#### The context gap

When AI doesn’t know what your business means. AI doesn’t know that “churn” means something specific
at your company. Without a semantic layer, they guess and sound confident while being wrong.

**Mosaic injects your business logic into every AI query before it runs. The model doesn’t just see
your data; it understands what it means.**

[filter_alt_100dp_FA660F_FILL0_wght400_GRAD0_opsz48.svg]

#### The logic silo problem

Business rules your AI can’t reach. When metrics live inside BI tools and spreadsheets, AI
agents can’t access them. Every agent reinvents the math inconsistently. 

**Mosaic decouples logic from consumption. One semantic layer governs dashboards, agents, and
applications simultaneously. Define once, apply everywhere.**

[calculate_100dp_FA660F_FILL0_wght400_GRAD0_opsz48.svg]

#### The accuracy trap

Why you can’t ask AI to do math. AI and large language models excel at language. They fail at
aggregation. Asking one to calculate quarterly revenue is a reliable path to hallucinated numbers. 

**Strategy handles the computation. AI handles the explanation. Accurate answers in natural language
without the risk of a model doing math it wasn’t designed for.**

[encrypted_100dp_FA660F_FILL0_wght400_GRAD0_opsz48.svg]

#### The security blindspot

What your AI agent can see that it shouldn’t. Most AI data tools bypass row-level security entirely.
A model that can access your data can also summarize it for the wrong person. 

**Every query through Mosaic passes through your existing RBAC rules before a single byte is
fetched. Governed AI isn’t a setting. It’s the architecture.**

[trending_down_100dp_FA660F_FILL0_wght400_GRAD0_opsz48.svg]

#### The cost trap

How ungoverned AI queries drain your cloud budget. AI agents that query raw data tables directly are
expensive by design. Each iteration against millions of rows compounds your compute spend invisibly,
until the bill arrives.

**Mosaic’s Smart Caching and push-down optimization routes every query intelligently. Your cloud
costs reflect your decisions, not your agents’ inefficiency.**

[01_Mosaic_Logo_Primary_Color.png]

## תתמקדו בתהליכים עסקיים

### פתרונות לאוטומציה של עיבוד נתונים ובינה עסקית

### [אוטומציה של ניתוח נתונים][12]

אוטומציה של עבודה ידנית בניתוח נתונים לחסכון בזמן ואמינות בנתונים

### [בינה עסקית בהתאמה][13]

ניתוח צרכים ותהליכים עסקיים, פיתוח פתרונות במערכת Power BI לבינה עסקית

### [יישומי מידע לניהול עסקי][14]

פיתוח אפליקציות בהתאמה לצרכים העסקיים על בסיס פלטפורמות ניהול נתונים של מייקרוסופט

## מה היתרונות?

להפיק את המירב מהקיים

[Compatibilities]

### פתרונות בהתאמה

פיתוח יישומים משלב האיפיון עד ההטמעה בהתאמה לצרכי הארגון תוך הפקת המירב בסביבת מייקרוסופט

[Save time]

### חסכון בזמן עבודה ידנית

פתרונות אוטומציה לניהול וניתוח נתונים מאפשרים לארגון להתרכז בתהליכי ליבה
תוך המרת עבודה ידנית בכלים אוטומטיים

[From data to knowledge]

### מנתונים למידע ובקרה

שדרוג תהליכים של עבודה עם נתונים לכלים המאפשרים לקבל תובנות ומידע בעל ערך על בסיס נתונים

[SEO]

### שיפור ביצועים עסקיים

אפליקציות לתמיכה בתהליכי קבלת החלטות מאפשרות גישה שיטתית בתכנון עסקי ויכולת התגובה לתנאי שוק משתנים

## למה אנחנו?

בזכות המחויבות, המקצועיות, הניסיון והתוצאות

[From data to knowledge]

### מגוון של עולמות תוכן תחת גג אחד

חברת אניפיט בע"מ מספקת פתרונות וכלים ממוחשבים עבור איסוף, ניהול וניתוח נתונים בהתאם לצרכי הלקוחות
ופתרונות בינה עסקית בסביבת מייקרוסופט. חברת אניפיט צברה במהלך השנים ניסיון רב בתחום פיתוח
באופיס וביצעה עשרות רבות של פרויקטים המשמשים לקוחות מכל גודל ומגזר עסקי. כמו כן, מתנהל באתר פורום

workplace relations, WHS, and more .

# Welcome to Channel Dive

It’s a new day for tech channel news at Industry Dive and Informa TechTarget.

Published Oct. 30, 2025
[ [Phil Harvey's headshot] ][27]
[Phil Harvey][28] Editor-in-Chief

Pelicans fly over the Salton Sea at sunrise on July 7, 2011, in Salton City, California. David McNew
via Getty Images

Welcome to Channel Dive.

We're Informa TechTarget's new publication, focused on delivering daily news and analysis for
executives at North American channel partners — the diverse ecosystem of companies that resell,
deliver and add value to technology products and services. 

The [business combination][37] of [Industry Dive][38], the Informa Tech media brands, and TechTarget
provided us with the opportunity to assemble new teams and implement positive changes in our
approach to this market. 

We've sunset the [Channel Futures brand and website][39] and launched [Channel Dive][40] to provide
solid, dependable reporting to channel partners, while making it as easy as possible for them to
follow the topics that matter most. 

The seven newsletters previously sent by Channel Futures have been consolidated into a single [daily
newsletter][41], now available at Channel Dive. We aim to make the Channel Dive Daily as helpful and
uncluttered as possible. 

We took a similar approach with the Channel Dive website, featuring a highly functional and
minimalist design. We believe our audience will appreciate the absence of clickbait slideshows and
shouty headlines labeling every exec who changes jobs a "superstar." 

The [Channel Dive team][42] will feature reporting by Channel Futures alum James Anderson and Senior
Editor Matt Ashare, previously of CIO Dive, along with contributions from writers you've read before
on Channel Futures and other Industry Dive publications. The team will be managed by me, in addition
to my [daily editorial duties][43] at Light Reading.

Our goal is to earn your trust as a fair and valuable source of daily news and insights for channel
professionals. Let us know how we're doing and what issues you'd like us to cover next at
[[email protected]][44].

Welcome to Channel Dive.

We're Informa TechTarget's new publication, focused on delivering daily news and analysis for
executives at North American channel partners — the diverse ecosystem of companies that resell,
deliver and add value to technology products and services. 

The [business combination][37] of [Industry Dive][38], the Informa Tech media brands, and TechTarget
provided us with the opportunity to assemble new teams and implement positive changes in our
approach to this market. 

We've sunset the [Channel Futures brand and website][39] and launched [Channel Dive][40] to provide
solid, dependable reporting to channel partners, while making it as easy as possible for them to
follow the topics that matter most. 

The seven newsletters previously sent by Channel Futures have been consolidated into a single [daily
newsletter][41], now available at Channel Dive. We aim to make the Channel Dive Daily as helpful and
uncluttered as possible. 

We took a similar approach with the Channel Dive website, featuring a highly functional and
minimalist design. We believe our audience will appreciate the absence of clickbait slideshows and
shouty headlines labeling every exec who changes jobs a "superstar." 

The [Channel Dive team][42] will feature reporting by Channel Futures alum James Anderson and Senior
Editor Matt Ashare, previously of CIO Dive, along with contributions from writers you've read before
on Channel Futures and other Industry Dive publications. The team will be managed by me, in addition
to my [daily editorial duties][43] at Light Reading.

Our goal is to earn your trust as a fair and valuable source of daily news and insights for channel
professionals. Let us know how we're doing and what issues you'd like us to cover next at
[[email protected]][44].

01
Uçtan Uca Teknoloji Yetkinliği
Altyapıdan güvenliğe, buluttan iş uygulamalarına kadar kurumların teknoloji ihtiyaçlarını bütünsel

başarıya odaklanıyoruz.

Esnek Yatırım Modelleri
Teknoloji yatırımlarınızı bütçe, ölçek ve büyüme planlarınıza uygun esnek modellerle destekliyoruz.
04
Türkiye Pazarında Lider Konum

operasyonel açıdan da değerlendiriyoruz.
05
Uzun Vadeli İş Ortaklıkları
Müşterilerimizle yalnızca proje bazlı değil, gelişen ihtiyaçlara uyum sağlayan uzun soluklu
teknoloji yolculukları tasarlıyoruz.
06
Üretim Zekâsı ve MAS+

ve operasyonel zekâ katmanı oluşturuyoruz.

operasyonel açıdan da değerlendiriyoruz.

teknoloji yolculukları tasarlıyoruz.

Üretim Zekâsı ve MAS+

ve operasyonel zekâ katmanı oluşturuyoruz.

RTX connects our world through the power of flight and protects it with industry-leading defense

## Business Performance Management

Optimization of all company management processes

BPM (Business Performance Management) systems are designed to optimise all company management
processes (planning, organisation of execution, control and analysis). BPM systems help to identify
and clearly formulate strategic goals of the company, to develop a plan for with the available
resources in mind, and to manage the performance of the organization at all levels, from top
management to the frontline employees.

Lasmart develops and implements BPM systems covering all tasks of strategic management, financial
management, marketing and operations.

What is business intelligence?

Business intelligence (BI) uncovers insights for making better, data-driven decisions. Business
intelligence tools collect, store and analyse data and present findings to create a comprehensive
view of a business.

Step 1: Data sourcing for storing and management raw data

Step 3: Data reporting and presenting it in an understandable way

Step 4: Taking action on insights in real-time

Step 5: Monitoring and prediction based on previous findings.

### .research

Currently, I am using meta-analysis to look for “original discoveries and contributions by mining
the untapped veins of information in accumulated research literatures.” ([Hunter & Schmidt 2004,
p. 21][6])

In general, I believe that research is inherently cross-disciplinary:
* Data science helps us to distill interesting patterns from human behavior.
* Qualitative research helps us to understand the meaning of these patterns.
* Experimental research and design research help us to use this understanding to build more
  effective information systems.

### .methods
* Meta-analysis
* Experiments
* Data Science
* Qualitative Document Analysis
* Philosophy of Science

### .projects
* Your Time for Science - A mobile platform for economic experiments
* The relationship of project control and project performance
* User participation, risk, and project performance
* Repeated interactions in IT outsourcing

### .log
* Köhn, T., Gottlieb, M., Schermann, M., Krcmar, H.: Improving take-over quality in automated
  driving by interrupting non-driving tasks at the 24th International Conference on Intelligent User
  Interfaces.
* Schermann, M., Merz, ML. “User Participation in Information Systems Projects: Necessary But Not
  Sufficient” at ECIS 2018
* Spring 2018 Data Visualization ([Syllabus][7])
* Spring 2018 ERP Systems ([Syllabus][8])
* Spring 2018 Financial Information Systems ([Syllabus][9])

## Do you really know who you’re dealing with?

We enter into contracts with companies every day. Each of those contracts was with something with
legal personality – almost always a "legal entity". Yet too often we're ignorant of them and who is
behind them, with all the attendant risks that brings.

Whether you're in business, government, journalism, activism, research or a consumer — [our
goal][39] is to help you better understand the companies you deal with.

Search the world’s largest open legal-entity database or plug the data direct into your applications
and processes.

Fresh, standardized, auditable information underpinned by our [Legal-Entity Data Principles][40],

behind them, with all the attendant risks that brings.

goal][39] is to help you better understand the companies you deal with.

Search the world’s largest open legal-entity database or plug the data direct into your applications
and processes.

## It shouldn't be hard to get legal-entity data you can trust

And yet it is. Legal-entity information is dispersed across hundreds of business registers that are
hard to navigate and impossible to access at scale. Traditional company-data aggregators are no
longer the answer either, given their opaque processes and provenance.

Verifiable accuracy is more important than ever, and you should expect more.

You need data built on deep expertise, rigorous data models and [well-founded, forward-looking
principles][43]. Data sourced direct from primary sources, curated with clear decision-making and no
hidden bias, and defined by open not proprietary identifiers and standards. Data you know you can
trust.

# Data Mining Fruitful and Fun

Open source machine learning and data visualization.

[Download Orange 3.40.0][8]

May 08, 2026

## [Gairdin: Traditional Slovenian Houses - Reinvented][9]

Students can now explore Slovenian houses in a completely unplugged way.

[[Gairdin: Traditional Slovenian Houses - Reinvented]][10]

Apr 14, 2026

### [Gairdin: Gnomes with the Youngest Students][11]

We explored what the gnomes are doing together with the youngest primary school students and had a
lot of fun along the way.

[[Gairdin: Gnomes with the Youngest Students]][12]

Dec 31, 2025

### [Orange Essentials: Interactive Workflows][13]

A new YouTube tutorial shows how to turn Orange into an interactive data exploration tool.

[[Orange Essentials: Interactive Workflows]][14]

Dec 24, 2025

### [Orange Essentials: Annotating Workflows][15]

A new YouTube tutorial shows how to annotate workflows in Orange.

[[Orange Essentials: Annotating Workflows]][16]

## Visual Programming

No coding needed. Place widgets on the canvas, connect them, load your datasets, and harvest the
insight!

[ Learn more][17][Watch video][18]

## Interactive Data Visualization

Explore statistical distributions, box plots and scatter plots, or dive deeper with decision trees,
hierarchical clustering, heatmaps, MDS, t-SNE and linear projections. Even your multidimensional
data can make sense.

[ Learn more][19]

## Extensions

Specialized add-ons can perform natural language processing and text mining, conduct network
analysis, do association rules mining, or address fairness in machine learning. Some address
specialized data, such as time series, survival data sets, spectra, or gene expressions. Also, check
out Orange's cousin [Quasar][20].

[Watch video][21]

## Teach with Orange

When teaching data mining, we like to illustrate rather than only explain. And Orange is great at
that. Used at schools, universities and in professional training courses across the world, Orange
supports hands-on training and visual illustrations of concepts from data science. There are even
widgets that were especially designed for teaching.

[Learn more][22]

My laboratory produces large amounts of data from RNA-seq, ChIP-seq and genome resequencing
experiments.  Orange allows me to analyze my data even though I don’t know how to program.  It also
allows me to communicate with my collaborators, who are experts in data mining, and with my
colleagues and trainees.

**Gad Shaulsky, Ph.D.**

Molecular biologist and Director of Graduate Studies (Baylor College of Medicine, Houston, USA)

The scientific community is in need of tools that allow easy construction of workflows and
visualizations and are capable of analyzing large amounts of data. Orange is a powerful platform to
perform data analysis and visualization, see data flow and become more productive. It provides a
clean, open source platform and the possibility to add further functionality for all fields of
science.

**Ferenc Borondics, Ph.D.**

Principal beamline scientist at SMIS (SOLEIL synchrotron, France)

I teach Orange workshops monthly to a diverse audience, from undergrad students to expert
researchers. Orange is very intuitive, and, by the end of the workshop, the participants are able to
perform complex data visualization and basic machine learning analyses. Most of our attendees have
been able to incorporate this tool in their research practice.

**Francesca Vitali, Ph.D.**

Research Assistant Professor (Center for Biomedical Informatics & Biostatistics, The University of
Arizona)

## Contribute to Orange

If you love using Orange and want to support us, a donation would be very much appreciated. The
funds help us fix bugs, implement new features, provide free educational content, and maintain
computational infrastructure.

## Visual Programming

No coding needed. Place widgets on the canvas, connect them, load your datasets, and harvest the
insight!

[ Learn more][17][Watch video][18]

## Interactive Data Visualization

Explore statistical distributions, box plots and scatter plots, or dive deeper with decision trees,
hierarchical clustering, heatmaps, MDS, t-SNE and linear projections. Even your multidimensional
data can make sense.

[ Learn more][19]

## Extensions

Specialized add-ons can perform natural language processing and text mining, conduct network
analysis, do association rules mining, or address fairness in machine learning. Some address
specialized data, such as time series, survival data sets, spectra, or gene expressions. Also, check
out Orange's cousin [Quasar][20].

[Watch video][21]

## Teach with Orange

When teaching data mining, we like to illustrate rather than only explain. And Orange is great at
that. Used at schools, universities and in professional training courses across the world, Orange
supports hands-on training and visual illustrations of concepts from data science. There are even
widgets that were especially designed for teaching.

[Learn more][22]

My laboratory produces large amounts of data from RNA-seq, ChIP-seq and genome resequencing
experiments.  Orange allows me to analyze my data even though I don’t know how to program.  It also
allows me to communicate with my collaborators, who are experts in data mining, and with my
colleagues and trainees.

**Gad Shaulsky, Ph.D.**

Molecular biologist and Director of Graduate Studies (Baylor College of Medicine, Houston, USA)

The scientific community is in need of tools that allow easy construction of workflows and
visualizations and are capable of analyzing large amounts of data. Orange is a powerful platform to
perform data analysis and visualization, see data flow and become more productive. It provides a
clean, open source platform and the possibility to add further functionality for all fields of
science.

**Ferenc Borondics, Ph.D.**

Principal beamline scientist at SMIS (SOLEIL synchrotron, France)

I teach Orange workshops monthly to a diverse audience, from undergrad students to expert
researchers. Orange is very intuitive, and, by the end of the workshop, the participants are able to
perform complex data visualization and basic machine learning analyses. Most of our attendees have
been able to incorporate this tool in their research practice.

**Francesca Vitali, Ph.D.**

Research Assistant Professor (Center for Biomedical Informatics & Biostatistics, The University of
Arizona)

If you love using Orange and want to support us, a donation would be very much appreciated. The

What is Flourish?
Flourish is a powerful data visualization platform that empowers the world to tell stories with
data. Trusted by organizations and newsrooms worldwide, Flourish helps creators bring data
narratives to life with highly engaging, interactive and impressive visualizations. Our extensive
library of templates and seamless embedding options make every data story informative and truly
captivating.


Who is behind Flourish?
Flourish was co-founded in 2018 by [Duncan Clark and Robin Houston][42]. Duncan has a background in
data journalism and publishing, while Robin is a mathematician and developer. In 2022, Canva
acquired Flourish with the shared goal of democratizing data storytelling and making data
visualization accessible to all. Read more about this [here][43].


How does Flourish differ from other data visualization tools?
Flourish sets itself apart through:
* **Ease of use**: No specific technical skills are needed thanks to its template-based system and
  intuitive user interface.
* **Storytelling**: Flourish is uniquely designed to facilitate narrative visualizations, such as
  scrollytelling, interactive presentations, and audio-driven stories.
* **Flexibility**: The Flourish SDK lets developers create custom templates without limitations on
  functionality or design.
* **Publishability**: All outputs are styled for robustness, capable of reaching unlimited
  audiences, and optimized for mobile viewing.


Is Flourish a business intelligence tool?
Flourish is not typically regarded as a business intelligence tool. While its templates and
[API][44] allow for data exploration and dashboard integration, its primary focus is on data
storytelling, especially for presentations and digital publications.

### Days of analysis, done in seconds.

Rill's AI agent runs dozens of queries to find the "why" behind your numbers so anyone can explore
large datasets without waiting on an analyst.

### One source of truth for your team and agents.

Establish a single, consistent version of truth for everyone in your organization through a "define
once, use everywhere" approach.

### Embedded analytics that match your brand.

Securely embed dashboards and data visualizations into your own applications, fully customizable to
match your company's colors, typography, and identity.

## One platform to *act* on data

01

### Get answers to any question

Ask open-ended questions using natural language to receive a visual, verifiable answer. Easily
enhance the AI's insights with your own expertise, seamlessly integrating machine and human
intelligence with a single click.

02

### Explore and explain data

Gain quick insights into metric shifts and identify data anomalies with comprehensive summaries of
their underlying root causes. Interactive dashboards allow users to intuitively filter, drill down,
and compare data for deeper exploration.

03

### Scale with BI-as-code

Define and govern all your BI assets as SQL and YAML code in a GitHub project. Go from data to
deployed dashboards using Claude or Cursor in minutes.

04

### Customize your dashboards

Canvas dashboards let you define your own visualizations and arrange them into your preferred
layout. You can display data, create visualizations, and add rich content from independent metrics
views.

05

### Embed analytics with style

Integrate custom-themed dashboards, with matching colors and typography, directly into your product.
Securely embed data and analytics to increase the value of your offerings.
